description: This file contains the server-side logic for the EditExam webpage, handling button click events that navigate to different pages within the Online Examination System.

classes.name: OnlineExamSystem.EditExam
classes.description: Code-behind class for the EditExam.aspx page, handling page lifecycle and button click events.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event. Currently no specific logic is implemented.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Handles the click event for the home button; transfers to AdminPanel.aspx.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Handles the click event for the profile button; transfers to AdminQueue.aspx.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Handles the click event for the leaderboard button; transfers to AdminLeaderboard.aspx.

methods.name: eTheoryB_Click
methods.description: Handles the click event for the Edit Theory button; transfers to EditTheory.aspx.

methods.name: eMcqB_Click
methods.description: Handles the click event for the Edit MCQ button; transfers to EditMCQ.aspx.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Handles the click event for the logout button; transfers to LoginPage.aspx.
